summary: Iteration 56 (chat retention purge + server-side global chat lock + custom voice player) tested end-to-end. Backend: new pytest suite test_iter56_chat_retention_and_lock.py — 17/17 passed (retention GET/POST persistence, presets [0,1,6,12,24,168,720], 422 on >8760h and negative, RBAC: user 403, authorized support agent GET 200 / POST 403, admin 200; chat master switch → HTTP 423 with French detail on both user and admin send endpoints while reads/deletes keep working, sends restored after re-enable; chat.purge_expired_messages() hard-deletes a 100h-old message with retention=1h while keeping recent one, and is a strict no-op at retention=0; retention worker startup log verified). Regression suite test_iter55_chat_telegram.py 21/21 still passing. Frontend (real preview URL, admin creds): admin Support tab shows chat-retention-box with all 7 presets + custom input + Appliquer; clicking retention-24 updates label to '✓ Actuellement : messages supprimés après 24 h (1 j)', custom 6h applies, retention-0 resets to 'jamais supprimés'. chat-global-toggle flips ACTIVÉ→DÉSACTIVÉ, floating chat-bubble disappears on user dashboard after reload and reappears after re-enabling. VoiceMessage custom player renders (play/pause pill + progress bar + 0:00/0:02 timers), zero native <audio controls> in DOM, icon toggles play↔pause and back, progress advances during playback. Regression: text send, right-click context menu, reply (with quoted preview), delete (confirm dialog → bubble becomes 'Message supprimé', persists after reload), mic button starts/cancels recording UI, image lightbox opens. Final state restored: chat_enabled=true, retention=0, leftover TEST support agent removed.

issues: Sub-24h retention labels show a days conversion that reads oddly: '✓ Actuellement : messages supprimés après 6 h (0.3 j)'. Suggest hiding the (x j) part when hours < 24.
Custom hours TextInput has no maxLength/validation hint inline; invalid values only surface through window.alert (works, but a native alert on web is inconsistent with the rest of the UI).

Recurring console error on every app screen: 'Invalid style property of "background". Please use long-form properties.' — pre-existing RN-web style bug (a gradient/background shorthand somewhere), harmless but pollutes logs.

action_items: Optional polish: don't render '(0.3 j)' for retention < 24h in SupportAgentsCard.

Optional hardening in VoiceMessage.tsx: Chromium reports duration=Infinity for MediaRecorder webm blobs. Currently fmt() falls back to '0:00' and the progress bar stays empty in that case. Apply the standard workaround (set audio.currentTime = 1e101 once on loadedmetadata, then reset to 0 on durationchange) so in-app recorded notes show a real duration. NOTE: not reproduced with a real in-browser recording (headless env has no mic input); the only webm rows in DB are 31-byte fakes from previous test iterations, which render 0:00/0:00 silently.
critical_code_review_comments: chat.py require_chat_enabled is applied only to the two send endpoints; DELETE/mark-read/heartbeat intentionally stay open — verified and matches spec. Good.

purge_expired_messages() deletes by created_at only (no conversation filter) — correct, but there is no index on chat_messages.created_at; consider creating one before volume grows so the 30-min purge and the sort in /api/chat/me stay cheap.
POST /api/chat/admin/retention correctly uses require_admin while GET uses require_admin_or_support — RBAC verified by test.

start_retention_worker sleeps 30 min AFTER the first pass, so a retention change takes up to 30 min to take effect; acceptable, but an immediate purge trigger on POST /retention would make admin feedback instant.
VoiceMessage.tsx has no error/failed-load state: if the audio blob is corrupt, play() rejects silently and the UI keeps showing 0:00 with no feedback.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST users via /api/auth/register (TESTret*), one temporary support agent (deleted), one valid 2s WAV voice note sent as admin (msg 3d912154-ceca-4509-8752-639d987d105a) kept for future voice-player E2E, plus a few TEST_iter56_* chat messages. All app_settings restored (chat_enabled=true, retention=0).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `python3 /app/backend/tests/seed_voice_message.py` to (re)create a valid WAV voice note for the custom player test; the existing webm rows in chat_messages are 31-byte fakes and render 0:00. ChatBubble delete uses window.confirm — Playwright auto-dismisses dialogs, so you MUST register page.on('dialog', accept) or the delete silently no-ops. Retention/global-toggle state lives in app_settings (keys chat_enabled, chat_message_retention_hours); always restore to true/0 (use /app/backend/tests/cleanup_iter56.py). Suite files: test_iter56_chat_retention_and_lock.py, test_iter55_chat_telegram.py.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found. One earlier false-negative during my own run: the right-click delete appeared to fail because Playwright auto-dismisses window.confirm; re-run with an accepting dialog handler confirmed delete works and persists after reload.
